detail: Installs a thin GitHub Actions workflow that calls the shared advisory slop reviewer in ForkHorizon/ci-gates. On every pull request it sends the diff to a local Ollama model and posts warning annotations for likely AI-slop (swallowed errors, fake tests, misleading names, insecure patterns). Advisory only: it never blocks the merge.

files.contents:
name: {{script_title}}

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: slop-review-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  slop-review:
    uses: ForkHorizon/ci-gates/.github/workflows/slop-review.yml@main
    with:
      runs-on: '{{runner_labels_json}}'

pullRequestBody:
Adds {{script_title}} managed by CI Scope.

This PR adds:
- `.github/workflows/{{script_slug}}.yml`

The workflow calls the shared advisory reviewer in `ForkHorizon/ci-gates`. On each pull request it reviews the diff with a local model and posts advisory `::warning` annotations for likely AI-slop. It is **non-blocking** and never affects the merge decision; tune or disable categories per repo via `.slop-review.json`.
summary: Advisory local-LLM review of PR diffs for AI-slop; never blocks the merge.
title: Slop Review
